reason: Design 1 delivers a cohesive, modern mobile banking experience that covers the critical steps of the brief clearly, whereas Design 2 feels like a rigid government web form with jarring error states (like separating validation errors onto an entirely blank screen).

Design 2 shows a cohesive, well-crafted banking flow that covers the key scenarios from the brief (including the close match and daily limit), whereas Design 1 looks like a generic government form and spends half its screens on disconnected error states without ever reaching the payment amount or review.

Design 1 has a complete, logical journey (Design 2 forgets to include a screen to actually enter the £650 payment amount in the happy path) and properly handles Confirmation of Payee states like 'Close match' with clear, accessible service-design patterns.

Design 1 delivers the full required user journey—including the actual grocery payments list and budget flow—on a coherent set of screens, whereas Design 2 uses three of its six screens on loading, error, and empty states and hides the required payment list behind another click.

Design 1 omits the payment amount entry screen from its primary happy path—jumping directly from the Confirmation of Payee check to the review screen with £650 already populated—whereas Design 2 provides a complete, logical end-to-end journey with accurate UK Confirmation of Payee ('Close match') handling.

Design 1 delivers a much more intuitive and cohesive user journey—allowing the customer to see their category budget and individual payments on the same screen, as well as set a budget—whereas Design 2 unnecessarily hides the 6 grocery payments behind an extra click and fixes minor UI glitches at the expense of basic product usability.
Design 1 shows the complete category and transaction data requested in the brief without truncation or layout bugs, maintains strong visual polish, and includes thoughtful edge-case states.
Design 1 is significantly cleaner and better polished, whereas Design 2 suffers from overlapping text, missing spaces in transaction rows ('Aldi15 Nov'), and redundant UI elements.
